title: SandboxUsageCorrectionRequest
description: Append-only Admin correction for one observed Sandbox usage fact. It never rewrites the original measurement or computes prices, balances, or invoices.

adjustment.description: Signed non-zero decimal delta. The corresponding original fact remains unchanged.

reasonCode.description: Stable metadata-only reason code; free-form user content is not accepted.

x-cloud-agents-semantic-constraints: confirmedSandboxId must equal the route sandboxId
expectedGeneration and expectedResourceVersion fence the exact Sandbox state
the selected metric must have a persisted raw usage fact before a correction is accepted
Idempotency-Key is required by the Admin HTTP operation
